Removing

Refitting

Open the bonnet lid.
1. (For the left headlamp only) Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the left engine compartment protection (1b).

1. Release the retainers (1a) and remove the cover (1b).

2. Disconnect the electrical connection.

3. Release the retaining spring moving it sideways.

4. Extract the bulb from the lamp.

If the lamp is working properly, avoid touching the bulb with your hands. If this does happen, clean the bulb with alcohol.

Removing

Check the condition and the cleanliness of the lamp.

Avoid touching the bulb with your hands. If this does happen, clean the bulb with alcohol.

1. Fit the lamp, positioning it as illustrated in the diagram.

Fasten the retaining spring.

Connect the electrical connection.

Position the cover and attach the retainers.

For the left headlamp only. Position the left engine compartment protection and secure it using the bolts.

Close the bonnet lid.

Check the operation of the bulb.
